tasks.title: Date-provenance honesty (mtime vs acquisition)
tasks.scope: EDIT `metadata.py` and `service.py` (+ tests). Builds on earlier tasks -- expect an already-modified tree. `date` may come from real acquisition metadata, from the filename, or from **file mtime** -- and mtime is frequently the COPY date, not the acquisition date, which silently manufactures a wrong date in the filename. (1) Distinguish these origins in the existing `sources` provenance map rather than collapsing them: an mtime-derived date must be distinguishable from a metadata-derived one (the current `"filename"` tag covers both filename and mtime heuristics -- split them). (2) Make the weaker origin visible to callers so C2 can flag it. INVARIANT E7: provenance must not pair a final (LLM-filled or edited) value with a key it did not come from. INVARIANT (lesson 34): this touches `metadata.py` extraction routing, so verification MUST run `pytest -q -m integration` explicitly as well as the fast suite -- the ImageJ/`_detect_format` tests are deselected by default. Do not regress `extract_metadata_detailed`'s 3-tuple return arity or `ExtractionDetail`'s existing fields (7 test fakes depend on both).
tasks.verification: Fast suite green (>= 217, the current baseline) AND `pytest -q -m integration` (must stay at 4 passed / 4 skipped -- no regression in the ImageJ tests). Tests must prove an mtime-sourced date carries a different provenance tag than a metadata-sourced one, and that a metadata-sourced date is unaffected. ruff + black clean.

tasks.title: Describer core: description -> provisional fields
tasks.scope: EDIT `llm.py` and `service.py` (+ tests). D1 (model resolution) is already done and committed -- do not revert its work. (1) Structure the free-text path: a user-written experiment description is parsed by the local model into the naming fields it can justify, and **only** those. (2) **Every field derived from the description is tagged provisional** (the user's explicit choice: "flagged provisional, need review"). Extend the provenance `sources` map with a distinct tag -- do not reuse plain `"llm"` if that would erase the distinction between "refined an extracted value" and "invented from prose". (3) The existing guardrails stay authoritative and must not be weakened: never fabricate beyond the description, omit over guess, and **never overwrite a value that real metadata already supplied**. A described field may only fill a genuine gap. INVARIANT: llm.py must never raise into the naming path -- no Ollama, a refused endpoint, or a malformed response degrades to "no suggestion" (prove the degraded modes, not just the happy path). `suggest_fields_with_ollama` already takes `user_description` and `suggest_for_file`/`plan_batch` already thread it -- this task structures and tags, it does not re-plumb.
tasks.verification: Fast suite green (>= 217). Tests (no network) must prove: a described field lands tagged provisional (a distinct tag, not plain "llm"); a field already supplied by metadata is NOT overwritten by the description; an empty/absent description changes nothing; a malformed model response degrades gracefully without raising. ruff + black clean.
